papers.title_en: Layer-Matched Sparse Attention for Low-Redundancy 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Sammam Mahdi, Fariha Binta Salim, K. M. Jubair Sami, Rakin Bin Rabbani
papers.evidence: 针对VGGT重建提出分层稀疏注意力改进
papers.tldr: VGGT能从无位姿图像中一次重建相机与几何，但全局注意力随视图数二次增长；常见免训练稀疏加速器在几何冗余低时容易损失位姿精度。论文提出LMSA，用逐层统计量及其逻辑值方差代理，区分聚合分散上下文的扩散层与依赖查询交互的匹配层，前者采用带权重要性采样枢纽键，后者保持精确注意力。在13个未见场景、32视图下，LMSA距稠密注意力仅差1.4 AUC@5，优于AVGGT与SAF3R；100视图时聚合器快2倍。结果表明按层保留不同类型信息，可在控制计算成本的同时提升低冗余三维重建精度。
papers.abstract_en: VGGT reconstructs cameras and geometry from unposed images in one pass, but its global attention grows quadratically with the number of views. Training-free accelerators thin this attention and work well on redundant video, but lose pose accuracy when views share little geometry. This paper traces these losses to two kinds of cross-view information that a uniform sparse approximation can fail to preserve together: diffuse layers aggregate distributed context, whereas matching layers depend on query-specific interactions that carry little attention mass. A per-layer statistic measures the log-mass missed by a mean token. Its row-free proxy is the logit variance, and it selects the estimator for each layer. Diffuse layers use shared, importance-sampled hub keys, with log-weights that make the softmax numerator and denominator unbiased. Matching layers stay exact: every aggressive thinning tested cost accuracy. At equal cost, the selected layers outperform the four shifted windows tested. On 13 unseen low-redundancy scenes with 32 views, LMSA stays within 1.4 AUC@5 of dense attention, compared with 10.3 for AVGGT and 4.5 for SAF3R; its difference from contemporaneous GPA-VGGT is not significant, and only its gains over AVGGT pass both scene-level tests. With 100 views, it stays within 1.9 AUC@5 while its aggregator runs $2.0\times$ faster. Used post hoc to choose the layers GPA-VGGT protects, the statistic improves it by 1.2 AUC@5 for 5% more FLOPs. Applied untuned to $π^3$, it beats AVGGT but remains further from dense accuracy.

papers.title_en: RageVLA: Augmentation-Trained Perception and Action for State-of-the-Art Robustness on LIBERO
papers.authors: Amrit Lal Singh, Smarak Kanjilal
papers.evidence: 通过场景与指令增强训练视觉语言动作策略，提升机器人操作在变化环境中的鲁棒性。
papers.tldr: VLA模型在常规LIBERO上表现趋于饱和，但物体移动、场景变化或指令改写，仍会令其在LIBERO-PRO上明显失效。RageVLA从数据与策略两端解耦动作和训练时的固定布局、环境及措辞：重排物体与任务场景并改写指令，再以DINOv3感知的物体位置和夹爪视野编码，配合TinyCLIP嵌入驱动动作生成。该模型以0.21B参数取得LIBERO-PRO 0.72分，超过此前最佳的0.53分；目标偏移28厘米时成功率仍为0.865。结果说明，系统增强数据并提供明确的场景表征，可有效提升VLA的迁移与鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models look saturated on LIBERO, yet most of them fall apart on LIBERO-PRO as soon as an object moves or the instruction asks for something new. We argue that what is missing is not scale but decoupling.   In these policies, what to do is tied to where things were during training, to the scene around them and to the wording of the instruction. We cut these ties in two places. In the data, LIBERO demonstrations are re-arranged by general rules: every object and fixture is moved and rotated, tasks are carried into other environments and onto other surfaces, and every instruction is paraphrased. In the policy, a perception engine on frozen DINOv3 features, trained on this augmented data, hands the action model the scene in decoupled form: a list of objects with their positions, and a compact code of what the gripper is looking at, next to image and instruction embeddings from TinyCLIP. A flow-matching diffusion transformer, trained from scratch, acts on this view.   We call this combination of Robust Augmentation and Grounded Encoding RageVLA. With 0.21 billion parameters, RageVLA sets a new state of the art on LIBERO-PRO among VLA policies, scoring 0.72 against 0.53 for the best published model, and a larger variant reaches 0.73.   Two further tests on LIBERO-Object show that the policy acts on what it perceives. When the object positions it is given are shuffled while the camera images stay correct, its success falls from 0.965 to 0.215. When the target object is displaced by 28 cm, it still succeeds in 0.865 of the episodes, where $π_{0.5}$, run through the same harness, succeeds in 0.105.

papers.title_en: SPICE: Stochastic Policy for Interaction in Cluttered Environments
papers.authors: Nidhi Parayil, Benjamin Greenland, Thierry Peynot, Chris Lehnert
papers.evidence: 机器人通过触觉与环境接触并操控障碍
papers.tldr: 采摘和修剪机器人常需穿过茂密枝叶抵达目标，接触不可避免，且遮挡会削弱视觉反馈；接触观测稀少也使策略难以学会适应性动作。研究提出触觉条件扩散策略 SPICE，仅依赖触觉，引导机器人穿越柔性枝叶、绕开部分阻挡枝干，并操纵挡路枝条。超过180次实机试验中，枝干绕行成功率达到95%，明显优于最强触觉基线的45%，并能在视觉遮挡下工作。它在未见番茄和酸橙植株上零样本成功率为87.5%，展示了触觉生成策略用于复杂植物环境交互的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Agricultural tasks such as harvesting and pruning require robots to reach through dense foliage, where contact is often unavoidable and vision is obstructed. Intermittent contact creates an imbalance between free-space and contact-rich observations, complicating the learning of contact-responsive behaviours. We present SPICE, a tactileconditioned diffusion policy for reaching targets in dense plant canopies using tactile sensing as the sole environmental feedback. SPICE exhibits three behaviours: moving through compliant foliage, manoeuvring around partially obstructing stems, and manipulating branches that block the target path. To the best of our knowledge, SPICE is the first tactile-conditioned diffusion policy for target reaching through physically cluttered plant canopies. Across over 180 real-robot trials, SPICE was evaluated against tactile-conditioned, image-conditioned, and reactive-control baselines. Spatial tactile information and explicit contact conditioning proved important, with SPICE achieving 95% branch-manoeuvring success versus 45% for the strongest tactile baseline. SPICE also achieved branch manipulation beyond the reactive controller and remained effective under visual occlusion, where the image-conditioned DP failed. Zero-shot transfer across 40 trials on unseen tomato and lime plants achieved 87.5% success rate. These results demonstrate the potential of tactile-conditioned generative policies for interaction in visually occluded plant environments.

papers.title_en: Improve How You Improve: Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Navigation
papers.authors: Yang Li, Ziju Han, Aming WU, Zihao Zhang, Sijia Zhang, Yahong Han, Qinghua Hu
papers.evidence: 通过反思与策略修订提升机器人在未知环境中的导航能力
papers.tldr: 零样本开放词汇多目标导航要求机器人在未见环境中连续寻找多个目标，并利用早先搜索经验提升后续效率。现有自改进方法会反思轨迹、修订规则，但诊断与修订机制通常由人设定且保持不变，难以随策略进步而演化。RPSI-Nav在修订导航程序的同时，也递归更新改进机制：必要时请求诊断视角，并用后续搜索反馈追踪规则效果。基准实验与真实机器人定性评估验证了其有效性，展示了同时改进导航与改进过程的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: To advance the development of embodied general navigation, zero-shot open-vocabulary multi-object navigation has attracted increasing attention, aiming to enable robots to efficiently search multiple objects in unseen environments without training. For this task, the key lies in improving navigation policies from earlier searches to locate subsequent goals more efficiently. Recent methods automate this process through trajectory reflection and rule revision, enabling policy self-improvement. However, the mechanisms for diagnosing problems and generating revisions are typically designed by humans and remain fixed across iterations. Consequently, the system's capacity for continued self-improvement remains constrained, even as its navigation policy evolves. To this end, we propose RPSI-Nav, a Recursive Policy Self-Improvement framework for zero-shot multi-object navigation that revises both the navigation program and its revision mechanism. RPSI-Nav diagnoses search behavior, requests diagnostic views when existing observations cannot distinguish competing causes, and generates targeted navigation revisions. Feedback from subsequent goal searches is linked to the rules that produced these revisions, guiding changes to diagnosis, observation acquisition, and revision planning. The updated improver governs subsequent navigation improvements, forming a recursive loop in which RPSI-Nav revises its own improvement process. Across goals, the robot conditionally inherits accepted program updates and spatial memory, enabling search experience to improve both future navigation and adaptation. Benchmark experiments and qualitative real-robot evaluations validate RPSI-Nav's effectiveness.

papers.title_en: CoT-WAM: Collaborative Training of Vision-Language Models and World-Action Models via Plan Latents
papers.authors: Jinhao Zhang, Yushen Zuo, Ke Rui, Weitao Zhou, Haibao Yu, Honglong Tian, Xiaoheng Ma, Jie Mei, Jiawei Wang, Minglei Li
papers.evidence: 联合视觉语言模型与世界动作模型，以计划潜变量支持场景理解、预测和机器人控制。
papers.tldr: 通用机器人操作既需要理解场景语义，也需要预判物理变化并规划动作；现有世界动作模型语义和长程规划能力有限，视觉语言模型的先验也难直接用于控制。CoT-WAM联合训练视觉语言模型与世界动作模型，以可学习的计划潜变量传递意图，并通过文本、目标图像监督及两阶段训练促进协作。它在LIBERO、CALVIN和RoboCasa-Kitchen取得最佳表现，在LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro展现更强零样本泛化，并改善RoboCasa365长程规划。真实机器人实验也验证其部署效果，表明语义推理与物理预测可通过协同训练提升操作能力。
papers.abstract_en: General robot manipulation requires both semantic competence and physical foresight. World action models (WAMs) acquire an understanding of and predictive capability over the physical world by jointly modeling visual foresight and action distributions. However, existing WAMs still lack semantic competence: they have limited ability to perform open-world scene understanding, semantic reasoning, and long-horizon planning. Although vision-language models (VLMs) provide these capabilities, effectively integrating their semantic priors into WAM prediction and control remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose CoT-WAM, a jointly trained WAM-VLM framework. CoT-WAM uses a learnable embedding to exchange information between the VLM and the WAM, which is supervised by textual and goal-image signals during training to encode rich intent information. A tailored two-stage training strategy enables joint optimization and more effective collaboration between the VLM and WAM. We evaluate CoT-WAM on six benchmarks covering control performance, zero-shot generalization, and long-horizon planning. CoT-WAM achieves SOTA performance on LIBERO, CALVIN, and RoboCasa-Kitchen, and demonstrates stronger zero-shot generalization on LIBERO-Plus and LIBERO-Pro without fine-tuning. On RoboCasa365, it further improves long-horizon planning over baselines with and without external planners. Real-world experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in practical deployments.

papers.title_en: LAGR: Language-Aware Grasp Re-Ranking for Task Oriented Grasping
papers.authors: Manav Kulshrestha, Shreyans Jain, Apoorva Vashisth, Ankush Gupta, Damon Conover, Aniket Bera
papers.evidence: 面向任务的机器人抓取选择与排序
papers.tldr: 机器人抓取既要满足物体上的物理可行性，也要适配下游任务；例如锤击时应握锤柄，递交时则可握锤头。现有任务导向抓取数据集规模小、偏合成或标注昂贵，限制了方法开发。为此，研究构建涵盖17类物体、100,911组图像与任务的真实观测数据集，包含268万条五自由度抓取评分标注，并提出LAGR：先生成任务无关候选及可行性分数，再以语言条件模型联合重排序。实验中LAGR较次优方法提升9.3个百分点，并在Franka机器人上完成真实物体抓取验证，为任务导向抓取提供数据与方法支持。
papers.abstract_en: Grasping is a fundamental capability for robotic manipulation, with the appropriate grasp depending on the downstream task. For example, a hammer should be held by its handle for hammering but by its head when it is handed over. Selecting such a grasp requires consideration of two criteria: physical feasibility on the object and suitability for the task. Developing such an approach requires dense grasp labels with both feasibility and task scores on real observations, but existing task-oriented grasping datasets are small, synthetic, or costly to annotate. To address this gap, we construct a dataset of 2.68 million scored 5-DoF grasp annotations over 100,911 image-task pairs from $17$ object categories. Additionally, we introduce LAGR, a task-oriented grasp detection method that explicitly addresses both these challenges. Given vision-language inputs, LAGR first generates task-independent grasp proposals along with a physical feasibility score, and then scores the generated grasps with a language-conditioned re-ranker that reasons over all proposals jointly. Experiments show that LAGR outperforms the next best method by 9.3 percentage points. We further validate LAGR on real objects by executing task-oriented grasps with a Franka Research 3 robot.

papers.title_en: Navigating Robots from Unknown and Uncalibrated Exocentric Cameras via Map Estimation
papers.authors: Raul Steinmetz, Raphael Druon, Yusuke Yoshiyasu, Akihisa Ohya, Ayanori Yorozu
papers.evidence: 从未标定外部摄像头估图并导航机器人
papers.tldr: 室内墙面或顶置外置摄像头视野更广、较少受遮挡，但传统导航方案要求预先标定相机位姿和内参，部署与换房间都不便。ROMUX不输入相机信息，也不针对特定相机训练或部署前微调，而是用跨视角变换器从图像预测机器人中心的米制障碍地图，再由PPO策略依据相对目标坐标导航。仿真中相机逐回合随机时，其成功率达到机载摄像头策略水平；单摄像头、多摄像头局部视野均可使用。系统还零样本迁移到不同相机位置与朝向的真实机器人，体现了降低部署门槛的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Exocentric cameras, mounted on walls or ceilings in indoor environments, offer wider vantage points and are less easily occluded than robot-mounted cameras, making them an appealing alternative for perception in robot navigation algorithms. Previous methods that use such cameras, however, require their pose and intrinsics to be known before deployment, demanding calibration that is time-consuming, requires specialized personnel, and must be repeated whenever a camera moves or a new room is navigated. We propose Robot-centric Obstacle Maps from Unknown and uncalibrated eXocentric cameras (ROMUX), an agent that navigates a robot toward point goals while avoiding obstacles using exocentric cameras that are both uncalibrated, meaning the system does not require their pose or intrinsic information as input, and unknown, meaning it is not fit to a specific camera during training and does not require pre-deployment fine-tuning. We train a cross-view transformer on large-scale simulation data to predict metric robot-centric obstacle maps from exocentric images, without conditioning image tokens on camera information. A small policy trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) then navigates on the predicted maps toward a goal coordinate relative to the robot. We benchmark our agent in simulation with cameras randomized per episode, and it matches the success rates of a PPO policy that navigates from a robot-mounted camera. Further, ROMUX works with one camera or multiple cameras with partial views and has been transferred zero-shot to a real robot using a camera at varying positions and orientations across various room layouts.

papers.title_en: A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments
papers.authors: Yuze Wu, Mo Zhu, Xingxing Li, Yuheng Du, Zhaoqi Wang, Yuxin Fan, Wenjun Li, Kenghou Hoi, Zhichao Han, Xin Zhou, Fei Gao
papers.evidence: 为无人机提出层级视觉语言导航与低层控制框架。
papers.tldr: 无人机要在复杂环境中理解场景并完成长程导航，但现有方案受三维训练数据不足、动作轨迹难以落地及机载算力有限等问题制约。VLN-AR采用分层视觉语言导航，将多模态推理与低层控制分离，并通过三维高斯泼溅自动生成仿真数据、渐进式三阶段训练和记忆感知任务分解增强导航能力。针对端侧部署，系统使用令牌稀疏化与模型轻量化，在保持较高导航性能的同时实现7.1至9.4倍加速。仿真和真实无人机实验均显示其优于现有方法，为资源受限平台上的复杂自主飞行提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. A progressive three-stage training strategy further enhances grounding, scene reasoning, and complex navigation. In addition, a lightweight cognitive agent improves long-horizon reasoning via memory-aware task decomposition. Finally, we design onboard optimization techniques, including token sparsification and model lightweighting, achieving 7.1x-9.4x speedup while maintaining high navigation performance on resource-limited UAV platforms. Experiments show great improvements over existing methods in both simulation and real-world UAV navigation. Project website: https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/

papers.title_en: Facet-SLAM: Real-Time Triangle Splatting SLAM
papers.authors: Edward Beng Wai Tan, Siew-Kei Lam
papers.evidence: RGB-D SLAM中的三角网格表面重建
papers.tldr: 三角形泼溅地图可直接形成连通网格，但既有系统依赖光度跟踪，难以达到传感器速率；建图优化还会移动三角形，使其不再适合作为几何配准目标。Facet-SLAM面向RGB-D相机，将跟踪与建图职责分离：用融合深度确定三角形质心，并以GICP配准，建图则通过变量变换限制为不平移更新。系统在桌面GPU上约100帧/秒，在Jetson AGX Orin上可达传感器速率，较光度方案快逾20倍；Replica网格倒角距离由1.55降至0.86厘米。该方法兼顾实时定位、渲染与表面几何，无需额外网格提取。
papers.abstract_en: Dense SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian splatting build maps that render photorealistically, but their surface geometry is poor, and obtaining a mesh requires extraction or fusion stages. Triangle splatting avoids this with surface primitives whose vertices can be triangulated directly into a connected mesh, yet SLAM with this representation has so far relied on photometric tracking, which is too slow for localization at sensor rate. We present Facet-SLAM, the first real-time triangle splatting SLAM system for RGB-D cameras. Fast geometric registration is the natural alternative, but it is not sufficient alone, since the mapper's optimization displaces triangles from the observed surface and makes them unreliable registration targets. We therefore separate the two roles: the tracker sets each triangle's centroid from fused depth and registers frames to these centroids by GICP, while the mapper is restricted to non-translating updates via a change of variables. Our system achieves competitive tracking accuracy at around 100 FPS on a desktop GPU and runs at sensor rate on a Jetson AGX Orin. Compared with the photometric approach, it is over 20 times faster, matches rendering quality, and improves surface accuracy, reducing the chamfer distance of the Delaunay mesh on Replica from 1.55 to 0.86 cm. We will release the implementation at https://github.com/edward62740/Facet-SLAM.

papers.title_en: 3DTouch: A Tactile-aware VLA Model with 3D Geometric Relations for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Xin Zhang, Shiqi Zhang, Siyuan Cao, Juncheng Cai, Yedong Shen, Yuxuan Gao, Dianlong Wen, Kaixue Long, Lu Zhang, Yao Li, Jiajun Deng, Yanyong Zhang
papers.evidence: 以三维视觉触觉关系增强灵巧机器人的接触操作。
papers.tldr: 接触密集的灵巧操作中，手指和物体遮挡会使视觉难以准确判断接触位置；外观相近的场景也可能因物体相对位置细微差异而需要不同动作。3DTouch将RGB-D点云与五指稠密触觉测量统一到机器人基座坐标系，并显式编码手物、物物几何关系，作为视觉语言动作模型的条件信息。在真实机器人五项任务中，成功率较对应基线提升42个百分点，较最强对比方法提升20个百分点。结果显示，共享空间定位、触觉力反馈与几何关系有助于调整接触和物体对齐，提升复杂操作可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: In contact-rich dexterous manipulation, occlusion by the fingers and interacting objects obscures local geometry, preventing visual observations from fully capturing contact locations. Visually similar scenes may also differ subtly in the relative positions of interacting objects, leading to different contact states. We propose 3DTouch, a tactile-geometric conditioning approach for vision-language-action (VLA) models. 3DTouch constructs a shared 3D visuo-tactile representation by expressing RGB-D scene points and dense five-finger tactile measurements in the robot-base frame, preserving each taxel's spatial location and force vector. Hand-object and object-object relations derived from hand landmarks and pose-aligned reconstructed surfaces explicitly describe the relative arrangement of interacting entities. Together, these representations condition the VLA action expert on spatially localized contact forces and relative surface geometry, providing explicit cues for contact adjustment and object alignment. We evaluate 3DTouch on five real-world contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks using a UR7e robot arm equipped with an XHand dexterous hand. 3DTouch improves the average success rate by 42 percentage points over the corresponding VLA baseline and by 20 percentage points over the strongest evaluated alternative. Ablation studies reveal the complementary benefits of scene geometry and spatial tactile feedback, with further gains from shared spatial grounding and explicit geometric relations.

papers.title_en: Freeforward4d: Annotation-free feed-forward 4d reconstruction of driving scenes
papers.authors: Luosong Guo, Xiang Yang, Chaoyang Li, Ao Gao, Jiangming Shi, Yanyun Qu, Zhizhong Zhang, Jingyu Gong, Yuan Xie
papers.evidence: 融合并校准相机、深度与轨迹先验，实现无标注驾驶视频的前馈四维重建
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶仿真需要可渲染的动态场景，但现有前馈重建依赖相机、激光雷达深度或三维框标注，难以处理未标注视频。FreeForward4D仅使用RGB，校准重叠多视角预测窗口并与单目度量深度对齐，统一时空几何后关联跨相机目标，以共享速度和局部高斯修正描述物体运动。Waymo上达到27.66 dB峰值信噪比和0.836结构相似度，无需尺度对齐即可恢复度量相机与深度，并在8秒窗口取得领先的RGB保真度。结果表明，协调视觉先验可替代数据集标注，为多数据集适配和高效驾驶场景重建提供新途径。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 4D reconstruction enables efficient creation of renderable driving scenes for autonomous driving simulation. However, most existing methods rely heavily on dataset-provided cameras, LiDAR depth, or 3D box annotations, limiting their applicability to unannotated driving videos. Pretrained visual models can predict cameras, depth, and object tracks from RGB alone, but their geometry is mutually inconsistent: multi-view predictions come in short windows with independent scales and frames, while monocular depth is metric only per image. Our key insight is that, once reconciled into a single metric frame, these priors can replace dataset annotations for feed-forward 4D reconstruction. We present \textbf{FreeForward4D}, which calibrates overlapping prediction windows against monocular metric depth and registers them into one frame across time. On this geometry, 2D tracks are associated across cameras in 3D, and objects move through hierarchical motion that combines a shared object velocity with local Gaussian corrections, so that both training and inference use only RGB videos. On Waymo, FreeForward4D achieves 27.66 dB PSNR and 0.836 SSIM while recovering metric-scale cameras and depth without scale alignment. It surpasses STORM, SLARM-F, UFO, DGGT, and StreetForward, which rely on dataset annotations, in full-image PSNR and attains the best RGB fidelity on 8-second windows. RGB-only fine-tuning further adapts the framework to nuScenes and Argoverse 2. Code will be released.

papers.title_en: JEPA Dots: Dual-Latent World Model for Language-Guided Robot Control
papers.authors: Xianhao Pan, Chi Li, Hanchao Li, Yunxin Liu, Jiankai Sun, Luhui Hu
papers.evidence: 通过世界模型预测环境动态并控制机器人完成操作任务
papers.tldr: 语言引导的机器人世界模型需要兼顾任务控制与可靠的动作后果预测：指令应改变动作选择，却不应改变相同观测和给定动作下的预测。JEPA Dots以动力学和任务双潜变量分离两类信息，让语言特征引导流匹配策略，并用掩码注意力隔离世界预测。模型仅约3910万参数，在40项LIBERO任务上取得84.9%的整体成功率；相较作者任务编号条件基线提升8.9个百分点，LIBERO-Goal提升21.4个百分点。实验还显示切换指令会改变任务表征和策略输出，而固定观测与动作下的动力学表征及预测保持不变，为紧凑型语言条件机器人控制提供了可验证的解耦方案。
papers.abstract_en: Predictive world models for language-guided robot control face a fundamental conditioning challenge: instructions should influence action selection without altering the predicted consequences of fixed actions under identical observations. To address this challenge, we introduce JEPA Dots (Dynamics-Oriented Task Separation), a compact dual-latent framework that jointly learns visual dynamics and language-guided control through separate dynamics and task representations. Language-conditioned task features guide a flow-matching policy, while masked attention restricts world prediction to instruction-independent dynamics history and supplied actions. In closed-loop evaluation on 40 trained LIBERO tasks, JEPA Dots achieves 84.9% overall success with approximately 39.1M parameters, compared with the published 78.7% of NanoVLA-S with 161.0M parameters under a different evaluation protocol. In the reference experiment, JEPA Dots also improves overall success from 76.0% for our task-ID-conditioned adaptation baseline to 84.9%, with LIBERO-Goal success increasing from 67.1% to 88.5%. Instruction-switching experiments further confirm that task representations and policy outputs respond to language changes, while dynamics representations and world predictions remain invariant under fixed observations and supplied actions.

papers.title_en: Ego2X: Contact-aware Transfer from Egocentric Human Data to Any Robot
papers.authors: Xinke Lyu, Bowen Yang, Zhicheng Wang
papers.evidence: 将第一人称人类交互视频转换为具物理接触的机器人数据。
papers.tldr: 具身模型需要真实交互数据，但在实体机器人上采集成本高；现有从第一视角视频迁移的方法偏重外观，常出现手指悬空、夹爪抓空等物理接触失真。Ego2X提出以物体为中心的接触表示CORE，记录表面锚点、相对作用力、抓取模式与交互状态，并贯穿校正、重定向和合成流程。实验中，接触深度误差降低33.7%，接触实现率达62.9%；仅用迁移数据训练后，任务成功率由40.5%升至67.0%。该工作推动人类视频转化为可执行的多类机器人数据。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied models depend on real interaction data, yet collecting it on physical robots is slow and labor-intensive. Recent ego-to-robot pipelines retarget first-person view human videos to robot data via transferring hand and arm motion. They judge fidelity mainly by visual appearance. However, trajectories often fail in terms of physics: fingers hover beside objects, and grippers close on empty space. We argue that how the object moves and the contacts that drive the motion count. Thus, we present Ego2X, an object-centric framework that converts monocular egocentric video into physically executable robot data across dexterous hands and parallel grippers. Ego2X centers on CORE (Contact-centric Object-interaction REpresentation), which records each contact on the object by its surface anchor, as well as relative force, grasp mode, and interaction state. Throughout the pipeline, CORE corrects hand-object drift via object-relative constraints, steers inverse kinematics toward contacts the robot must realize, and preserves held objects during arm erasure and robot compositing. On HOT3D, contact-driven correction reduces in-contact hand depth error by 33.7%, while on EgoDex, contact-driven retargeting realizes 62.9% of annotated contacts, surpassing the official HuRo pipeline (27.9%). In RoboTwin 2.0, post-training X-VLA on Ego2X episodes alone, without simulator demonstrations, raises task success rate from 40.5% zero-shot to 67.0% across 200 paired scenes. We will publicly release our conversion pipeline and CORE-annotated dataset for dexterous hands and parallel grippers.

papers.title_en: BEV-Diffusion: Camera-Only Traversability Navigation with BEV Memory and Efficient Cross-Robot Adaptation
papers.authors: Iana Zhura, Timofei Kozlov, Dmitrii Plotnikov, Ivan Valuev, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Dzmitry Tsetserukou
papers.evidence: 从相机视频预测可通行性地图和导航路径。
papers.tldr: 机器人导航既要看懂场景、判断地形能否通行，也要快速适配不同平台；传统方案常依赖昂贵激光雷达、长时间建图和复杂模块。BEV-Diffusion 仅用相机，将连续图像融合为带不确定性的鸟瞰通行图，并由扩散模型生成路径，结合度量记忆保留视野外障碍。未知庭院中路线完成率达 96%，黄昏也无需人工干预；微调约 3% 参数即可在 2.3 分钟内适配小型机器人，室内任务进展达 67%–100%。这表明联合学习地图、路径与置信度可提升导航可靠性及跨机器人迁移效率。
papers.abstract_en: Robot navigation requires both an understanding of the scene and an efficient adaptation to new robots, yet current methods rely on expensive LiDAR sensors, long mapping and modular pipelines. We present BEV-Diffusion, a camera-only model that learns a bird's-eye view (BEV) traversability map, its uncertainty and the path in a single network. A frozen DINOv2 backbone encodes consecutive RGB frames, which inverse perspective mapping and Bayesian fusion lift into the BEV, and a ranking loss keeps outdoor traversability graded rather than binary, separating asphalt from grass (median 0.94 vs. 0.75). On this map, a transformer denoiser generates polar waypoints in a few DDIM steps, and uncertainty-aware guidance refines the path and ends it where the map is no longer reliable. At deployment, a metric BEV memory keeps obstacles after they leave the camera view and warm starts each sample from the previous, ego-motion compensated path. Because the planner jointly learns the path, the map, and its uncertainty, it selects routes through terrain it can confidently traverse. In an unseen courtyard, a wheeled-legged robot autonomously traveled 120 m, completing 96% of the route without intervention, compared with 75-88% for the baselines. Even under low-light conditions after sunset, the proposed model completed the route without requiring any intervention. Retraining only the BEV head, about 3% of the parameters, adapts the model to a small legged robot in 2.3 min. Indoors, the memory gets this robot out of maze-like traps: it retains 62-66% of the nearby out-of-view obstacles, against at most 3% for the baselines, and the robot achieves 67-100% task progress, compared with 20-40% for the evaluated baselines.

papers.title_en: TapTacTouch: Shape Completion from Sparse Tactile Contacts with Geometric Priors
papers.authors: Yoobin Shin, Jaeyoung Lee, Jieun Kang, Hyun Song, Woojin Kim, Andrew Jaeyong Choi
papers.evidence: 从机器人稀疏触觉接触重建三维网格
papers.tldr: 机器人在遮挡严重或缺乏视觉的环境中，难以仅靠视觉可靠重建物体形状；稀疏触觉接触又无法直接覆盖完整表面。本文提出无需视觉、训练或类别先验的重建框架，将多指手压力阵列经机械臂运动学转为三维接触约束，并结合多尺度高斯过程隐式表面及几何先验补全未观测区域。在六个真实物体上，方法取得95.00的F分数，平均每个物体重建用时49.99秒。结果说明少量触觉观测也能支持连续三维形状重建，为视觉受限场景中的机器人感知与操作提供新途径。
papers.abstract_en: 3D object reconstruction is essential for robotic perception and manipulation, yet conventional approaches predominantly rely on visual observations that can be limited by occlusion or unavailable in visually constrained environments. In this work, we propose a vision-free, training-free, and category-agnostic framework for reconstructing 3D object meshes from sparse tactile contacts without relying on pretrained shape models. A 6-DoF robotic arm equipped with a 20-DoF multi-finger robotic hand collects tactile observations using 3x3 pressure sensor arrays mounted on the finger pads. The acquired tactile measurements are transformed into 3D contact constraints through robot kinematics and integrated into a multi-scale Gaussian Process Implicit Surface (GPIS). To address sparse and incomplete surface observations, the proposed method incorporates contact confidence weighting, weak pseudo-surface constraints, and an observation-driven geometric prior to preserve local surface geometry and provide structural guidance in unobserved regions. Real-world experiments on six objects achieve a Chamfer Distance (CD) of 1.610, an Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) of 7.738, and an F-Score of 95.00, with reconstruction completed in an average of 49.99 s per object. These results demonstrate that sparse tactile sensing can provide sufficient geometric information for continuous 3D object reconstruction without visual or semantic information.

papers.title_en: RAPID: Reconstruction Accelerated by Polarization-Informed Depth for 2D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Daisong Ouyang, Linlin Xia, Liangkun Yan, Song Gu, Shedong Zhao, Xin Dai, Yi Zheng
papers.evidence: 从多视图图像重建三维表面，并融合深度与法线先验
papers.tldr: 多视图高斯表面重建常依赖稀疏几何初始化与迭代致密化，优化耗时较高，在反光和弱纹理区域也难兼顾渲染质量与几何精度。RAPID以几何优先为思路，利用多视图偏振线索恢复稠密表面先验：结合稀疏几何锚点将法线融入深度图并跨视角融合，再进行曲率自适应采样和定向高斯初始化。在PISR数据集上，相较PhyGaP优化约快5倍，耗时从约21分钟降至4分钟，同时保持有竞争力的新视角合成与网格重建表现。该方法展示了偏振几何先验加速高斯重建的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient and accurate 3D surface reconstruction from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge in Gaussian splatting. Many existing methods rely on sparse geometric initialization and iterative densification, resulting in substantial optimization overhead and difficulties in balancing rendering quality and geometric accuracy, particularly in reflective and weakly textured regions. To address these limitations, we propose RAPID, a geometry-first framework that uses multiview polarization cues to recover dense surface priors. We integrate surface normals into depth maps using sparse geometric anchors. These depth maps are then fused across views. Curvature-adaptive sampling and oriented Gaussian initialization then support efficient optimization. Experiments on the PISR dataset demonstrate an approximately \(5\times\) speedup over PhyGaP, which is a state-of-the-art Gaussian-based reconstruction method. RAPID reduces the average optimization time from approximately 21 minutes (PhyGaP) to 4 minutes while maintaining competitive novel-view synthesis quality and mesh reconstruction accuracy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of RAPID in accelerating Gaussian optimization from polarimetric multi-view inputs.

papers.title_en: SHAPE: Discrete Supervision and Parallel Continuous Streams for Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Human Data
papers.authors: Yaping Li, Zhihong Liu, Jiacheng Li, Yi Yang, Wenchao Yue, Mingzhe Ye, Xiangcheng Liu, Yiyang Chen, Haotian He, Qi Zhang, Haonan Wang, Dahua Lin, Zhijie Deng
papers.evidence: 将第一人称人类操作记录转化为灵巧机器人策略的动作监督信号。
papers.tldr: 灵巧机器人示范成本高，第一视角人类记录虽便宜，却因人机形态与运动学不同，缺少关节位置和执行器指令。SHAPE用末端动作块的离散令牌监督骨干网络，并由共享流匹配专家并行生成末端与关节动作。六项任务评测显示，机器人示范下关节读出得分0.80，高于π0.5的0.63；人类到机器人的迁移则更适合逆运动学末端读出。该方法让人类数据既能塑造动作表征，也能支持无任务专属机器人数据的新技能学习。
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric human recordings are far cheaper than dexterous robot demonstrations, promising stronger pretraining and direct skill learning without task-specific robot data. Yet humans and robots differ in morphology and kinematics, so human recordings lack the joint positions and actuator commands that supervise robot policies, providing only retargeted end-effector (EEF) actions. This raises two questions: how human data should supervise the policy, and how a dexterous robot should read out actions at deployment. We address both in SHAPE (Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams), a vision-language-action (VLA) model whose backbone predicts discrete action tokens of EEF chunks as an auxiliary task, while a shared flow-matching expert outputs two executable streams, EEF and joint. On a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands, a matched study shows that discrete supervision helps learn from human data, driving backbone gradients and shaping action-informative representations across domains. Under standard control pipelines at deployment, direct joint readout excels at fine-grained control with robot demonstrations, scoring 0.80 across six tasks against 0.63 for π0.5, whereas IK-based EEF readout excels at human-to-robot transfer. Pretrained with human data and discrete tokens, SHAPE learns new tasks from human demonstrations without task-specific robot data.

papers.title_en: HandWorldBench: A Unified Benchmark for Hand-Centric World Models
papers.authors: Zhaolu Wang, Jiacheng Xu, Lihong Wang, Shuqing Wang, Jianjie Fang, Ziyou Wang, Xvyuan Liu, Rongze Tang, Yiding Ma, Xin Zhang, Jiawei Chen, Wei Wu, Chen Gao, Yong Li, Zhibo Chen
papers.evidence: 跨真人、仿真手与真实灵巧手评估交互世界模型
papers.tldr: 手物交互要求世界模型既理解手部动作如何改变物体，也能维持变化后的状态，但针对这些能力的系统评估仍较缺乏。HandWorldBench以人手、模拟灵巧手和真实灵巧手为对象，从视觉质量、手部保真、外观一致、指令遵循、物理一致和时间连贯六方面统一评测。研究从600余小时素材中筛出20,500段高质量第一视角片段，并人工选取500段、覆盖七类任务，测试11种模型。结果显示，手姿控制强不等于物体状态演化连贯或跨具身稳健，部分专用模型在灵巧手任务上不及通用视频生成模型；该基准为能力诊断与模型比较提供了系统工具。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in world models are opening new possibilities for fine-grained embodied tasks, with hand-object interaction offering a particularly demanding setting. Modeling these interactions involves capturing how hand actions change objects and how the resulting states persist over time. Yet systematic evaluation tailored to these hand-centric capabilities remains underdeveloped. To address this gap, we introduce HandWorldBench, a unified benchmark that systematically evaluates hand-centric world models across human hands, simulated dexterous hands, and real dexterous hands along six dimensions: visual quality, hand fidelity, appearance consistency, instruction following, physical consistency, and temporal coherence. To construct the benchmark, we develop a data curation pipeline that extracts hand-object interaction clips and screens them for quality, yielding 20,500 high-quality egocentric clips from over 600 hours of footage. We then manually select 500 clips covering seven task families for evaluation. Benchmarking eleven models under a unified protocol reveals that stronger hand-pose control does not consistently translate into coherent object-state evolution and persistence or robust cross-embodiment performance, with several specialized hand-control models underperforming general-purpose text/image-to-video generators on dexterous-hand tasks.

papers.title_en: DiWALI: Diffusion Policy Learning in World Models via Latent Action Inference from Human and Robot Play
papers.authors: Akshay L Chandra, Iman Nematollahi, Lingyue Zhao, Daria Kulikova, Angela P. Schoellig, Fabien Despinoy, Abhinav Valada
papers.evidence: 从人类与机器人交互数据学习操作策略和世界模型
papers.tldr: 机器人操作学习常受限于带动作标签的机器人数据；人类演示容易获取，却无法直接提供机器人动作。DiWALI用逆动力学从连续画面推断潜在动作，并以机器人操作数据训练解码器，将潜在动作映射为机器人命令。框架据此从无动作标注的人类示范学习扩散策略，再在融合人类与机器人操作数据的世界模型中通过想象强化学习改进策略。CALVIN实验显示，仅用人类示范训练的策略优于机器人示范基线；人类数据也能提升微调效果，实体机器人实验进一步验证策略可在想象中改进。该方法展示了人类经验兼顾技能学习与策略优化的潜力，可减少对动作标注机器人数据的依赖。
papers.abstract_en: Learning robot manipulation is constrained by the availability of action-labeled robot data, for both imitation and world models. Humans can demonstrate skills in seconds, but their demonstrations lack the required robot actions. We introduce DiWALI, a framework that learns and improves diffusion policies within a world model trained on human and robot play. DiWALI infers latent actions from consecutive frames using an inverse dynamics model, enabling world model training without action labels, and grounds them in robot commands through a decoder trained separately on robot play. Skill policies are trained over latent actions from action-free human demonstrations and improved with reinforcement learning in imagination. On the CALVIN benchmark, DiWALI policies trained solely from human demonstrations substantially outperform baselines trained with robot demonstrations. Incorporating human play into the world model training also yields stronger policies after fine-tuning than using the same amount of robot play alone. Experiments on a physical robot show that skills learned primarily from human demonstrations are further improved in imagination with a world model trained on human and robot play. Together, these results demonstrate that human experience can support both manipulation skill acquisition and subsequent policy improvement, reducing reliance on action-labeled robot data. Videos, dataset and code are available at https://diwali.cs.uni-freiburg.de.

papers.title_en: NereidVLA: Learning to Understand and Navigate the Underwater World
papers.authors: Chenjie Zhao, Zhiliang Zhu, Quan Chen, Yuquan Xue, Xingxue Shi, Puyue Wang, Zhiqiang Zhao, Kangye Zheng, Boyang Xu, Mingwei Lin, Dejun Li
papers.evidence: 视觉语言动作模型依据指令预测水下机器人三维运动轨迹
papers.tldr: 水下导航需要把视觉空间线索转化为运动指令，但海洋视觉语言数据集通常缺少配对机器人轨迹，限制了模型学习导航动作。研究先以约两百万条海洋样本训练Sea2Know，学习目标定位、空间关系与场景结构，再用模拟动力学下的专家轨迹适配NereidVLA。模型根据图像历史和语言指令预测离散动作，并生成供闭环跟踪的局部三维轨迹。空间预训练使仿真成功率由72.4%升至84.4%；未经真实测试环境微调，泳池机器人成功率达78.75%，优于对照模型的47.50%，显示海洋空间知识可迁移至实体导航。
papers.abstract_en: Underwater navigation requires translating visual spatial cues into motion, yet marine vision-language datasets rarely include paired robot trajectories. We present NereidVLA, a vision-language-action model that transfers marine spatial knowledge to language-conditioned 3D navigation. We first train Sea2Know on approximately two million marine examples to learn target grounding, spatial relations, and scene structure without paired robot-motion supervision. We then adapt it using expert trajectories executed under simulated underwater vehicle dynamics. Given RGB histories and a language instruction, NereidVLA predicts discrete motion tokens that decode into local 3D trajectories for closed-loop tracking. Evaluation combines an independent six-dimensional underwater navigation understanding benchmark with offline prediction and closed-loop navigation. Under matched navigation training and execution settings, marine spatial pretraining increases simulation success from 72.4% to 84.4%. Without fine-tuning on the real test environment, NereidVLA achieves 78.75% success in laboratory-pool robot trials, compared with 47.50% for InternVLA-N1. These results show that marine spatial supervision can support downstream motion learning and physical underwater navigation.

papers.title_en: DORMS: Image Segmentation via Depth-Ordered Region Merge Trees
papers.authors: Furkan Mumcu, Yasin Yilmaz
papers.evidence: 从单目深度构建区域合并树，直接实现层级图像分割。
papers.tldr: 图像分割通常依赖学习模型，而单目深度提供了可用于解析场景几何的线索。DORMS以现成深度估计器输出为输入，通过并查集扫描构建深度有序合并树，并利用区域面积、深度持久性和空间接触决定合并。它还通过全局深度去趋势强化局部结构，并搜索阈值以匹配指定区域数。在COCO Panoptic、Cityscapes和ADE20K上，该方法优于经典基线；尤其在Cityscapes上超过所有评测的零样本模型。结果显示，纯算法几何推理无需学习分割参数，也能达到有竞争力的分割效果。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce DORMS (Depth-Ordered Region Merging for Segmentation), a purely algorithmic approach to image segmentation from monocular depth maps, requiring no neural networks or learned parameters in the segmentation process. An off-the-shelf monocular depth estimator provides the input depth maps. Our method constructs depth-ordered merge trees through a deterministic union-find sweep, combining component area, depth persistence, and spatial contact constraints to guide region merging. A threshold search determines the segmentation granularity according to a specified target region count, while global depth detrending improves the separation of local geometric structures. Extensive experiments on COCO Panoptic, Cityscapes, and ADE20K demonstrate consistent improvements over classical segmentation baselines and competitive performance against zero-shot neural segmentation models. Notably, our method outperforms all evaluated zero-shot models on Cityscapes, while remaining competitive with several approaches on COCO and ADE20K. These results highlight the potential of purely algorithmic geometric reasoning for image segmentation without learned segmentation models.

papers.title_en: Cleanly-DINO: Efficiently Learning Visual Task Spaces for Robotics
papers.authors: Adrian Röfer, Melika Shekarriz, José Arce y de la Borbolla, Iman Nematollahi, Abhinav Valada
papers.evidence: 从视觉示范学习机器人清洁任务空间并定位未完成区域
papers.tldr: 少演示操作学习通常依赖能描述任务进度的表示；清洁任务的完成体现为视觉状态变化，难以用物体位姿刻画。Cleanly-DINO利用任务区域掩码与冻结视觉变换器特征，学习任务相关视觉子空间及进度度量。论文在多样清洁样例上评估未完成区域定位和跨视觉域迁移，并考察其作为强化学习观测编码器、奖励信号及真实机器人擦拭引导的用途。该方法探索了面向清洁操作的任务表示，为少演示机器人执行提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Learning manipulation tasks from few demonstrations requires abstractions that capture the changes relevant to task completion, such as object poses in rigid-body manipulation. However, tasks such as cleaning are defined by changes in visual state rather than object pose, making the choice of task representation less clear. In this work, we propose Cleanly-DINO to learn visual task spaces from few demonstrations. Given a mask of a task-relevant region and frozen ViT features, Cleanly-DINO fits a projection to isolate a task space and fit a progression metric to it. We train the model on diverse cleaning examples and evaluate its ability to localize incomplete task regions and transfer across visual domains. We also study its utility for robot learning by using it as an observation encoder and reward signal in a reinforcement learning setting. Finally, we deploy our fitted model within a real-world robotic wiping pipeline to evaluate its use in guiding task execution.

papers.title_en: Radar Panoptic Transformer: Semantic-Guided Mask Queries for Dynamic Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Mayank Mayank, Bharanidhar Duraisamy, Rohit Mohan, Abhinav Valada
papers.evidence: 雷达点云上的动态场景全景语义分割
papers.tldr: 汽车雷达可提供远距离感知和多普勒速度，但点云稀疏、采样不均，动态目标往往仅有少量检测点，难与占主导的静态背景区分。RPT采用雷达自适应点特征提取，融合姿态对齐的时序信息，并由点级语义预测初始化查询，通过类别一致性引导掩码注意力生成实例掩码。模型还利用实例级雷达散射截面一致性损失约束预测。它在RadarScenes上达到71.6%语义交并比与82.2%全景质量，在MAN TruckScenes上优于所测基线，并以31赫兹实时运行，展示了面向远距离全周向雷达场景的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Automotive radar provides long-range sensing and direct Doppler velocity measurements, but its sparse and non-uniformly sampled point clouds pose significant challenges for panoptic segmentation. Dynamic objects often yield only a few detections amid a dominant static background, providing limiting the geometric cues for separating object instances. We propose \emph{Radar Panoptic Transformer (RPT)}, an end-to-end point-based network that incorporates radar-adaptive feature extraction with semantic-guided mask prediction. Its backbone aggregates pose-aligned temporal context through grouped vector attention and learns per-point neighborhood radii conditioned on range, azimuth, and radar cross section (RCS). Point-wise semantic predictions initialize queries at likely foreground detections and guide masked cross-attention through query-point class agreement, producing instance masks without geometric clustering. An auxiliary RCS-consistency loss matches instance-level statistics between predicted and annotated instances. RPT achieves state-of-the-art performance on RadarScenes with $71.6\%$ mIoU and $82.2\%$ PQ. We further evaluate RPT on MAN TruckScenes, where it outperforms the evaluated baselines in a long-range, full-surround radar setting with sensing ranges up to $230\,\mathrm{m}$. RPT achieves real-time end-to-end inference at $31$\,Hz on RadarScenes, exceeding the sensor frame rate.

papers.title_en: InterRSGaussian: Interactive Multi-view Instance Segmentation for 3D Remote Sensing Scenes
papers.authors: Zipeng Qi, Zhengxia Zou, Zhenwei Shi
papers.evidence: 直接研究多视角三维场景的交互式实例分割
papers.tldr: 交互式实例分割有助于按用户提示定位目标，但现有方法主要处理单视角图像，难以完整感知复杂三维遥感场景。本文构建包含五个场景、每个场景约百个视角的多视角遥感数据集，并提出基于三维高斯的 InterRSGaussian。用户可从任意视角点击目标，模型无需人工标注即可生成跨视角一致的实例分割，还能投影到点云形成三维分割。先验蒸馏网络用于提升初始化效率与分割表现，推动遥感目标理解从二维走向可交互的多视角三维框架。
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing image segmentation plays a critical role in various applications. Interactive instance segmentation, a specialized task within image segmentation, aims to generate precise segmentation results for target objects based on user input prompts. However, previous studies on interactive instance segmentation primarily focus on single-view images, limiting their ability to comprehensively understand complex 3D remote sensing scenes. In this study, we extend interactive instance segmentation from a single-view to a multi-view framework, which can also be easily converted to a 3D segmentation format, thus achieving more accurate and comprehensive 3D remote sensing scene perception across multiple views. First, we construct a multi-view interactive instance segmentation dataset for remote sensing, comprising five distinct scenes, each captured from about one hundred different views. Second, we propose InterRSGaussian, a novel instance segmentation method based on 3D Gaussians. InterRSGaussian enables users to provide point clicks on target objects from any arbitrary view and generates view-consistent instance segmentation results across all input views without requiring manual annotations. The resulting multi-view segmentation can further be projected onto 3D point clouds for 3D segmentation. To improve training efficiency and segmentation performance, we introduce a prior distillation network for initialization. Overall, this study extends traditional 2D remote sensing scene perception into a 3D multi-view framework, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of target objects in complex environments with user interactivity.

papers.title_en: ReScene: Incremental Scene Chronology from Sparse Revisits
papers.authors: Wei Qin Chuah, Zeji Hui, Amirali Khodadadian Gostar, Alireza Bab-Hadiashar
papers.evidence: 稀疏重访条件下的增量场景重建与历史状态保存
papers.tldr: 场景跨小时或数日回访时，物体可能移位、消失或变形，而每次只有少量图像；既要保留所有历史状态，又要避免重复保存完整模型或覆盖旧状态。ReScene将每次回访编码为不可变紧凑更新，依次应用即可精确恢复任一历史状态，无须留存旧图像。它借助高斯合成权重定位差异，更新旧表面并以多视角深度补入新表面。相较顺序检查点，历史存储减少2.5至4.8倍；同等渲染质量下，前景深度误差较ChronoGS降低3.2倍，并提供含非刚性形变与材质移除的Multi-State基准。
papers.abstract_en: Scene chronology aims to reconstruct a scene across visits separated by hours or days, during which objects may change in position, presence or shape. Such reconstruction must retain every earlier state, yet each revisit often provides only a few images. Storing a complete model for each visit duplicates the unchanged scene, whereas updating a single shared model alters earlier states. We present ReScene, which stores each visit as an immutable compact update, so that any earlier visit can be recovered exactly by applying the stored updates in order, without retaining past images. To localise each update, ReScene attributes the disagreement between the preceding reconstruction and the new images to individual Gaussians through their compositing weights. This attribution guides the suppression of outdated Gaussians and the refinement of persistent ones, while newly visible surfaces are initialised from learned multi-view depth. We also introduce Multi-State, a benchmark of non-rigid deformation and partial material removal, including synthetic scenes with ground-truth geometry. ReScene achieves quality higher than sequential 3DGS checkpointing with 2.5--4.8$\times$ less uncompressed history storage. At comparable PSNR, it also reduces foreground depth error by 3.2$\times$ relative to sequential ChronoGS, showing that accurate rendering does not necessarily imply accurate geometry. Code and benchmark are available at https://waychin-weiqin.github.io/ReScene/.

papers.title_en: OCLDA-GS: Object-Centric Local Deformation-Aware Gaussian Streaming
papers.authors: Ashim Dahal, Nikesh Subedi, Rabab Abdelfattah, Nick Rahimi
papers.evidence: 对象中心的动态高斯表示支持多视角视频中的在线三维场景重建
papers.tldr: 动态场景的流式三维高斯重建需要兼顾传输效率、物体运动和边界细节；现有锚点选择与邻域插值容易忽略物体特有运动，造成边界不一致。本文提出物体中心的局部形变感知框架，动态分配物体与运动感知锚点，按物体限制邻域，并用物体刚体变换辅助学习局部形变修正。在相同细化预算下，三套数据集的峰值信噪比均优于即时高斯流基线，提升0.169至0.202分贝；部分数据集细化间画质跌幅亦减少。该方法为高效流式重建带来更稳定的物体边界与形变表现。
papers.abstract_en: Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for online reconstruction of dynamic scenes from multi-view videos for Free Viewpoint Video (FVV). Current time and storage efficient methods rely on selecting a subset of anchor Gaussians and neighborhood interpolation for fast streamable 3DGS. However, these methods can overlook object-specific motion and introduce inconsistencies near object boundaries. We propose OCLDA-GS, an object-centric streaming framework that dynamically reallocates object and motion-aware Gaussian anchors to allocate anchor Gaussian support for objects undergoing large motion while at the same time, restricting the gaussian neighborhood within object groups for more precise object boundaries. Furthermore, it estimates object-wise rigid transformations (e.g. a hand moving) and leverages these estimates to learn per-anchor local deformation correction for small deformations (e.g. wrinkles on a shirt). Then, we conduct experiments on three dynamic multi-view video datasets and demonstrate improvements over the previous baselines alongside improved quality between refinement timesteps. Under matched refinement budgets, our method improves PSNR over Instant Gaussian Stream (IGS) by 0.169 dB on N3DV, 0.202 dB on Meeting Room and +0.199 on Google Immersive, while reducing the mean PSNR drop between refinement timesteps by 9.2% and 13.8% in N3DV and Meeting Room, respectively.

papers.title_en: GRID-UAV: Geometry and Ray-depth Integrated Decision-making for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
papers.authors: Anas Anwarul Haq Khan, Amrin Kareem, Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Biplab Banerjee, Muhammad Haris Khan
papers.evidence: 将三维几何与射线深度用于无人机决策
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型主要依赖二维图像特征，难以可靠判断无人机的远距离障碍、飞行高度及前视与下视画面的空间关系，直接加入深度也未明显提升长航线成功率。GRID结合两种互补的三维信息：将两路单目深度转换为无人机坐标系中的射线校正位置，并在训练时对齐冻结多视角几何模型特征，推理时不增加额外开销。在TravelUAV的3,005个测试回合中，该方法各划分成功率均领先，未见地图上相对最佳基线提升25.4%。结果说明，几何对齐与显式三维位置结合，有助于兼顾避障和抵达目标。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) encode images with 2D encoders that capture little 3D structure. A common approach is to feed the policy estimated depth, but a UAV chooses its own altitude, must judge distances tens of meters away, where monocular depth is less reliable, and must relate its forward and downward views. On long aerial routes, adding depth features directly brings no significant gain (42.5% vs. 42.6% success), so we study how 3D information should be given to the policy. Analyzing flight failures, we find that two forms of 3D grounding fail in opposite ways: explicit 3D lifting of depth collides less on the way but more often fails to finish at the target, while implicit alignment with a 3D geometry model finishes more often but collides more. We propose GRID, which combines both: (1) it lifts monocular depth into ray-corrected 3D positions in the UAV's frame for both cameras, and (2) during training only, it aligns its visual features with a frozen multi-view geometry model, at no inference cost. GRID adding explicit lifting to implicit alignment significantly increases how often the policy reaches the target ($61.5\% \rightarrow 69.5\%$, $p<0.001$), and adding implicit alignment to explicit lifting significantly increases how often it completes the task once there ($57.7\% \rightarrow 61.4\%$, $p<0.05$). On TravelUAV (3,005 test episodes), GRID achieves the best success rate on every split, with relative gains over the state of the art of 9.5% (seen), 17.1% (unseen objects) and 25.4% (unseen map).

papers.title_en: Panini- Feasible Grammar For Robot Designs
papers.authors: Mayukh Debnath, Manan Roy Choudhury
papers.evidence: 以几何语法生成机器人形态与操作技能
papers.tldr: 机器人设计需要兼顾可解释的符号结构与连续几何，但现有方法往往难以统一技能和形态生成。本文提出带类型的产生式语法，以角色关系、参数继承和特异性仲裁组合操控技能与机器人形态，并映射到三维刚体变换。实验显示，几何包含关系可较好恢复仲裁决策；形态搜索平均排名最佳，但未显著胜过强通用优化器，协调肢体编辑的联合可行率达95%。其主要贡献是让设计结构透明、合法且几何协调，但可行设计不一定能行走，语法搜索也不代表普遍更优。
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic methods make robot designs interpretable but often overlook continuous geometry; learned methods handle geometry but offer less transparent structure. We introduce a typed production grammar that uses case-role relations, parameter inheritance, and specificity-based rule arbitration to generate both manipulation skills and robot morphologies. A geometric realization map translates grammar composition into transformations in SE(3), behaving as a monoid homomorphism when inheritance is inactive and exhibiting a measurable defect when inheritance is enabled. The grammar provides a compact representation, and its arbitration decisions can be recovered from geometric containment (agreement 0.905 +/- 0.062 across 10 seeds, versus 0.611 +/- 0.090 for a Euclidean control). We also introduce PANINI, a cross-entropy search method over grammar-based morphology representations. Across 30 methods and 24 seeds, PANINI achieves the best mean rank but is not statistically distinguishable from strong generic optimizers. Its main demonstrated advantage is therefore structural rather than optimization performance: grammar-generated designs are legal by construction, and coordinated limb placement produces 95% jointly feasible edits, compared with 55% for range-constrained resampling and none for flat parameterization in 6,000 draws. These results show how typed grammars can make robot generation more interpretable and geometrically coordinated, without implying that every feasible design will locomote or that grammar-based search universally outperforms generic optimizers.

papers.title_en: LuxTac: A Flexible, Scalable, and Open-Source Optical Taxel Array with Distributed Three-Axis Force Sensing for Tactile Robot Learning
papers.authors: Md Rakibul Islam Prince, John Pelan, Zhiyuan Zhang, Adyaa Khera, Katherine Pesetski, Adeesh Desai, Akimizu Sugiyama, Minwoo Ki, Benjamin Alan Capelle, Temitope Ibrahim Amosa, Zijie Xu, Yihan Huang, Taehun Chung, Long Wang, Wei Li, Shaoting Lin, Yu She
papers.evidence: 机器人通过触觉感知与物体交互
papers.tldr: 低成本触觉阵列有助于机器人学习，但压阻方案只能测压力，能感知剪切的相机式传感器又难以铺设在夹爪上。LuxTac采用约3.5毫米厚的光学税点阵列，以数字式RGB传感器读取硅胶层反射光，并通过可替换凝胶卡匣分别测量法向力或逐点三轴力。实验显示，法向力响应线性度R²达0.999，剪切测量合力各轴R²为0.92至0.96，剪切方向中位误差为4.8度。将其压力读数用于机器人策略后，插销入孔成功率显著优于仅使用视觉的基线；开源设计也便于扩展应用。
papers.abstract_en: Low-cost tactile arrays have made touch a practical input for robot learning, but piezoresistive designs sense only pressure, while camera-based sensors that also resolve shear are too bulky to tile over a gripper. To solve this problem, we present LuxTac, a flexible, scalable optical taxel array, about 3.5 mm thick and built from off-the-shelf parts. Each taxel is a digital RGBC light-to-digital converter under a translucent white silicone layer capped by an opaque black film, so the back-scattered LED light falls monotonically with local indentation depth. The same board accepts two interchangeable gel cartridges: a plain one for normal sensing, and one with colored walls that encodes the local shear in the color of the returned light, with no camera, magnets, or bump overlay, making LuxTac, to our knowledge, the first optical taxel array to resolve shear at individual taxels. Characterized with an automated CNC indenter and a six-axis force/torque sensor, the normal cartridge responds linearly to force ($R^2$ = 0.999) from 104 mN to at least 5.8 N, with 2.0% repeatability, 5.9% hysteresis, and a taxel-to-taxel variation of 6-10% after normalization. With the shear cartridge, per-taxel models estimate the three-axis force at every taxel; across three indenter shapes and nine held-out sessions, the summed estimates reach $R^2$ = 0.96/0.96/0.92 in x/y/z, each taxel's estimate 0.92/0.93/0.94, and the median shear-direction error is 4.8 degrees. Adding LuxTac pressure readings to an Action Chunking Transformer policy substantially improves peg-in-hole success over a vision-only baseline. Design files, code, and videos are available at https://luxtac.github.io.

papers.title_en: DOCK: Dual-Stream-Inspired Self-Supervised Object-Centric Representations Grounded in Robot Kinematics
papers.authors: Pengju Liu, Caiwen Ding
papers.evidence: 利用机器人运动学学习面向对象的操作表征
papers.tldr: 潜在空间规划通过比较未来图像与目标图像的嵌入来选择动作，但嵌入距离未必对应物体离目标有多远。研究发现，六种冻结的DINO与V-JEPA特征几乎不追踪物体距离，且容易受背景和机械臂影响。DOCK借鉴视觉的“是什么”与“在哪里、如何运动”双通路，从抓取运输轨迹和机器人运动学中学习物体令牌、空间标尺及动力学预测器。它在21项模拟任务中完成15项，与真实物体位置预言机相当，优于掩码几何和冻结特征，并可迁移到未见布局及物体类别。
papers.abstract_en: Latent-space planners select actions by comparing the embedding of a predicted future image with that of a goal image. This assumes that distance in the embedding reflects how far the scene is from the goal. We profile this assumption with simulator-executed futures, which removes prediction error. For six frozen DINO and V-JEPA encoders, feature distance barely tracks the object's distance to its goal: the rank correlation is at most 0.11, against 0.87 for object-mask centroids. It is dominated by background and robot patches, and frozen-feature readouts capture the arm far better than the object. Inspired by the ventral (what) and dorsal (where/how) visual streams, we propose DOCK, which learns an object representation whose changes agree with measured physical motion. A grasped object moves with the gripper, so forward kinematics on the joint angles gives a proxy for the object's displacement without annotation. From 9,951 held-object transport trajectories in 21 simulated kitchen scenes, we mine 404K displacement pairs and train three components: an object token pooled from patch features (what), a spatial ruler that makes differences of readout coordinates equal to measured displacements (where), and a dynamics predictor over object tokens (how). Used as a planning cost, the learned representation places the object in 15 of 21 tasks, as many as an oracle that reads the true object position, while mask geometry reaches 10 and frozen feature distance 9. It still solves the most tasks when the unseen robot arm is visible, and its ranking transfers to held-out layouts with unseen object instances and categories without any adaptation.

papers.title_en: Autoregressive View Model
papers.authors: Jensen, Zhou, Samuel Rota Bulo, Denis Rozumny, Duncan Zauss, Peter Hedman, Nikhil Keetha, Philip Torr, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi, Peter Kontschieder
papers.evidence: 基于Transformer的多视图场景重建与视角生成
papers.tldr: 从图像或视频生成可控视角片段，需要兼顾已见内容的重建与插值，以及未见区域的外推；显式三维建模并非唯一途径。AVM以统一上下文接口接收视觉输入和相机路径，并从输入及生成历史检索相关视图，形成有界活动上下文。模型经流匹配微调双向视频扩散变换器，再用自身生成轨迹训练因果模型，训练数据约涵盖800万场景与视频片段。多类基准评测考察其视觉质量、动态、重建和长程一致性，结果显示它能适配多种输入输出设定，体现了直接生成连贯视图流的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. Through a unified in-context interface, AVM conditions on images or videos to generate short clips along a requested camera path. Visual context grounds reconstruction and interpolation, while a learned prior enables extrapolation into unseen regions. AVM retrieves relevant views from inputs and generated history to form a bounded active context. We fine-tune a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion transformer with flow matching in an N-in-1-out formulation. We then tune a causal model on its own rollouts to improve photorealism, reduce denoising steps, and limit long-horizon drift. We scale training to approximately 8M scenes and video clips. We evaluate generation capacity and scene persistence across benchmarks for camera control, text control, visual quality, dynamics, sparse and 4D reconstruction, and long-horizon consistency. The results demonstrate that AVM adapts to diverse input and output settings through one in-context interface.

papers.title_en: Trust the Ray, Not the Depth: Ray-Lateral Agreement for Multi-View 3D Human Pose Fusion
papers.authors: Farnoosh Koleini, Ahmed Helmy, Pu Wang, Xiwu Cao
papers.evidence: 利用相机标定和视线几何校正多视图三维人体重建
papers.tldr: 多相机系统直接融合单目人体网格时，各视图结果可能相差一米以上；焦距假设不匹配使误差主要沿各自视线方向，而相机标定恰好提供了射线方向。RLA遵循“信射线、不信深度”：先沿射线校正深度，再依据射线方向建模误差并逐点闭式融合。它还只用各视图残差中垂直于自身射线的部分判断可靠性，避免误罚正常的射线向分歧。在公开基准的二至四相机、三种估计器设置下，RLA的最坏情况误差均低于三角化基线，为多视角姿态融合带来更稳健的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Put a monocular mesh estimator behind every camera of a calibrated rig, and the reconstructed bodies land a meter or more apart. The cause is geometric: each estimate sits at the depth implied by a focal length the network assumed, not the one the camera has. Its error therefore points almost entirely along its own viewing ray, and the calibration tells us that direction exactly. To address this, we introduce the Ray-Lateral Agreement (RLA), which follows one rule: trust the ray, not the depth. RLA first slides every estimate along its own rays, which removes the depth bias and leaves the shape untouched. It then fuses the views one point at a time, under a Gaussian error whose precision follows each viewing ray. The maximum-likelihood solution is closed-form, interpolates between averaging and midpoint triangulation, and stays well conditioned where triangulation is singular. Robustness is the harder half, because correct views also disagree along their rays. Any weight built on the full residual therefore punishes good views together with bad ones. Ray-lateral agreement instead scores every view, at every point, by its residual across that view's own ray alone. We evaluated RLA on multi-camera public benchmark datasets. Across two, three, and four cameras and three per-view pose estimators, RLA consistently achieves lower worst-case error than all triangulation baselines.

papers.title_en: What Do Learned 3D Models Add to Localization from Posed References?
papers.authors: Jaehyun Kim, Wonseok Kang, Jeongmin Lee, Tae-Wan Kim
papers.evidence: 比较学习式三维模型的相机预测与几何定位
papers.tldr: 从少量带位姿参考图像定位查询图像，可避免构建三维点云地图，但学习式三维模型相对几何估计究竟增加什么、何时失效仍不清楚。论文在五个测试集上比较八种模型及变体，改变参考图数量、位姿分量与输入参考选择，并检验几何估计及其回退方案。严格误差阈值下，剑桥与NAVER B1中，几何法多用一张参考显著优于所有模型用两张，且从未显著更差；三张参考时优势依场景而变。结果表明模型平移尺度收益高度依赖检索与参考布局，跨地点干扰会造成阶段性失败，稳健对齐可部分弥补，揭示了模型定位能力的条件与边界。
papers.abstract_en: Localizing a query from a few posed reference images avoids building a 3D point map. We ask what the camera predictions of learned 3D models add to geometric estimation from the same references, and where failures arise. Across eight learned models and variants and five test sets, we compare reference budgets, swap pose components, and intervene on the references a model sees. At fine pose-error thresholds, geometric estimation with one additional reference is significantly more accurate than every model on two references on Cambridge and NAVER B1 and never significantly worse, alone or as a fallback behind a shared acceptance gate; with the same three references, the more accurate approach depends on the scene. The gain from the learned translation magnitude depends on reference selection: it improves seven of the eight models on 12-Scenes with the spread-out pairs we select, but none of the five we test with the two top-ranked retrieved references. Where retrieval also returns references from other locations, at NAVER Gangnam Station, models fail at different stages. A robust alignment brings Pi3X and MapAnything within 3.3 pp of adding references as needed. In controlled tests, aligning on the nearby references largely restores VGGT, Pi3X and MapAnything but not Depth Anything 3, and pose-conditioned Pi3X recovers only if the far poses are masked and left out of its input-pose normalization.

papers.title_en: GaussLearner: 3D Gaussian Primitives as Self-Regulating Continual Learners
papers.authors: Gaoxiang Linghu, Haonan Zhou, Xuanhe Liu, Weili Xu, Kaiyue Zhou, Jun Xiao, Gaoang Wang
papers.evidence: 以三维高斯场持续维护不断变化世界的重建
papers.tldr: 持续观测不断变化的三维场景时，直接微调高斯场容易遗忘此前仍然有效的内容，现有局部优化、回放与正则化也难兼顾适应和保留。GaussLearner将每个三维高斯基元视为持续学习者，先把观测中的像素不一致归因到基元，再依据当前证据与跨状态可靠性调节学习权重，并同步控制参数更新和优化器记忆刷新。误差消除后的适应结果又更新基元可靠性，形成局部自调节、整体耦合的学习机制。在多个数据集上，其平均峰值信噪比比最强基线高3.41分贝，并在CL-3D变化与未变化视图均取得最佳重建质量，为动态场景持续重建提供兼顾更新与记忆的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning of 3D Gaussian fields aims to maintain faithful reconstructions of the evolving world. However, directly fine-tuning an existing Gaussian field on new observations can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously reconstructed content. To address this challenge, existing methods employ selective local optimization, replay, or parameter regularization, yet still struggle to balance adaptation to scene changes with preservation of still-valid content. Our key insight is to view 3D Gaussian primitives themselves as self-regulating continual learners. Based on this insight, we introduce GaussLearner, which equips each Gaussian with a closed continual-learning loop connecting observation, self-regulation, and adaptation at the primitive level. At each novel state, GaussLearner first attributes pixel-wise inconsistencies in current observations to their contributing Gaussians. Each Gaussian then self-regulates through a learning weight that balances current observations against cross-state reliability. This weight governs both Gaussian parameter adaptation and optimizer memory refresh. As current inconsistencies are resolved, the adaptation outcome renews each Gaussian's reliability for future states. The resulting field is a globally coupled population of locally self-regulating learners. Across scenes from CL-Splats, WAT, and our CL-3D dataset, GaussLearner improves average PSNR by 3.41 dB over the strongest baseline. On CL-3D, it achieves the best reconstruction quality on both changed and unchanged views.

papers.title_en: Detect What You Need: Chain-of-Causal Reasoning for 3D Intent Grounding
papers.authors: Zihao Zhang, Aming Wu, Yang Li, Yahong Han
papers.evidence: 依据抽象意图在三维场景中定位目标物体
papers.tldr: 三维意图定位需要从抽象、非描述性的语言中推断用户真正需要的功能，再从三维场景中找到合适对象；仅靠隐式意图—对象匹配容易出现逻辑断层，也不易解释和泛化。本文提出因果链式推理框架CoCR，将意图逐步拆解为有序功能需求，并以功能依赖图刻画需求与对象属性的关系。因果视觉对齐模块进一步把功能推理与点云几何、语义特征相连，支持推理结果和视觉证据双向核验。实验显示，CoCR在三维意图定位和三维视觉定位任务中均改善了面向意图的对象定位，为抽象需求的可解释匹配提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Accurately matching human intentions in 3D space is an important goal of artificial intelligence. Recently, 3D Intention Grounding (3D-IG) has emerged, aiming to localize target 3D objects given a natural-language intent. Unlike conventional visual grounding with descriptive referring expressions, 3D-IG intents are abstract and non-descriptive, making object localization substantially more challenging. This requires inferring latent functional requirements from non-descriptive intents and aligning them with object-level 3D representations. However, existing methods largely rely on implicit intent-object matching, leading to logical gaps and limited interpretability, robustness, and generalization. To address these challenges, we propose Chain-of-Causal Reasoning (CoCR), a causality-inspired functional dependency reasoning framework that explicitly bridges abstract intentions and candidate objects through intermediate functional requirements. Specifically, CoCR progressively decomposes complex intents into ordered functional requirements, thereby forming an explicit intent-function-object reasoning chain that links abstract intentions to object suitability. Building on this chain, we construct a causality-inspired functional dependency graph to model requirement-attribute relationships and introduce a causal-visual alignment module that aligns function-aware representations with the geometric-semantic features of 3D point clouds, enabling bidirectional verification between structured functional reasoning and visual evidence. Extensive experiments on 3D Intention Grounding and 3D Visual Grounding demonstrate that our method enhances intent-aware object localization. Our code is available at https://2490o.github.io/CoCR.
